page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g6.4xlarge is a general-purpose virtual instance based on the KVM hypervisor and powered by the x86_64 Intel Xeon 8269CY processor clocked at 2.5 GHz. The configuration provides 16 dedicated virtual CPUs across 8 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading enabled. The CPU subsystem is equipped with 32 KB of L1 data cache per core, 1.0 MB of L2 cache per core, and a shared 35 MB L3 cache, alongside support for instruction sets including AVX-512, AVX512_VNNI, and AES. Memory allocation is set at 64.0 GB of RAM, preserving a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio of 4.0 GB per virtual core. Network performance is provisioned with a baseline bandwidth of 5 Gbps. The instance includes no local storage and zero hardware accelerator GPUs, relying entirely on network-attached block storage for persistence.

Empirical benchmark testing places the instance predominantly in the middle 50% tier across multi-threaded computational and memory-intensive evaluations. The system achieved a Geekbench multi-core score of 7205.0 and a multi-core stress-ng rating of 13974.04, reflecting consistent parallel execution capacity. PassMark measurements reported an overall CPU score of 15381.15 and 5576.02 on database operations. Large-block uncached memory transfers yielded 89.18 GB/sec for reads and 46.34 GB/sec for writes, supporting memory throughput for demanding processes. Single-thread performance showed relative limitations, placing in the lower quartile for single-core stress-ng tests at 1310.38 and single-threaded gzip compression at 22.76 GB/sec.

The balanced hardware profile yields steady resource efficiency for general production workloads without the premium overhead of specialized high-frequency or GPU hardware. The absence of integrated local NVMe storage requires offloading I/O to network volumes, which should be factored into I/O-intensive architectures. With redis performance reaching 13.43 million SET operations per second and static web throughput measuring 11.32 GB/sec, the instance is well suited for enterprise application backends, container orchestration nodes, relational and key-value databases, and continuous integration pipelines.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g6.4xlarge is a general-purpose compute instance built on the x86_64 architecture and KVM hypervisor, powered by a 2.5 GHz Intel Xeon 8269CY processor. It provides 16 dedicated vCPUs from 8 physical cores, 64.0 GB of system memory, and a 5 Gbps baseline network interface. The instance features no local storage and no GPU accelerators, using network-attached volumes for persistent data. Multi-core compute benchmarks align with mid-range expectations, producing a Geekbench multi-core score of 7205.0 and a PassMark CPU score of 15381.15, supported by uncached memory read bandwidth of 89.18 GB/sec. Single-threaded metrics show lower relative throughput, with stress-ng single-core execution scoring 1310.38. With balanced resource ratios, the server delivers consistent compute and memory density for production web serving, medium-scale database operations, Redis caches, and distributed application workloads.
